## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `a11y` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T07:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the pager block of `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` is `domain:ui`. The area is `area:records`, as for #11690.
- **Why p3:** a screen-reader user cannot tell the four page buttons apart, on every paged grid. Sighted use is unaffected. That is the same weight as #11690.
- **Direction:**
  - Each of the four `Button`s gets an `aria-label` through the file's own `useTableTranslation`: first, previous, next and last page. ⛔ Do not use literal English.
  - Add the four keys to `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` and to the locale packs that carry `table.*`.
- **Pins:**
  - `getByRole('button', { name: … })` finds each of the four through a real paged `ObjectGrid`, the query the #12123 test could not use;
  - a localized name under a non-English locale.
  - `Clause-②: no`.
- **Sequence:** PR #12123 (#12081 item 3) edits the same pager's test. Pick this card up after it merges. Its chevron-icon lookup can then switch to the role query. This is ordering, not a block.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`
Account: `zhuangjianguo`
Branch: `claude/issue-12124-pager-button-names`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12124`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (the four pager buttons and `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`); the `table.*` blocks of `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (all ten packs); the paged-grid test that #12123 left on a chevron-icon lookup (named in the PR); new pins; `.changeset/12124-pager-button-names.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S` mechanical with translations, `M` treatment for the locale pins; `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`; the `Clause-②: yes` below owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by an isolated reviewer before the queue
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `objectui's data-table renderer (packages/components), whose four pager buttons are icon-only with no accessible name, so a screen-reader user cannot tell first, previous, next and last apart on every paged grid | the file's own useTableTranslation, which its other controls already use for aria-label | every screen-reader user of a paged grid`
Thread-read: 6106865988
Serial constraints cleared: none blocking. Read at 2026-10-11T11:00Z:
- PR objectui#12123 (objectui#12081 item 3), the ordering triage named, merged as `69bca0af`. The dev starts from that code.
- `data-table.tsx` last moved on 2026-10-08T05:38Z. No open objectui PR touches it or the locale packs.
- This seat's in-flight objectui#12110 edits `packages/components`' `form.tsx`, a different file.

Clause-② is `yes`, against triage's `no` (`6106865988`). The four keys go into `@object-ui/i18n`'s published packs, and that widens `TranslationKeys`, the same reading as objectui#12098 (contract review `6106856741`). The isolated review decides the direction. If the keys stay within `components`' own `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` and no pack moves, the line is `no` and the report says so.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#12142 (head `1b02eac714`) · `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`, 2026-10-11T13:52Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6109512642`). One patch round, changeset prose only.

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`, first line `Fixes #12124`, and `Clause-②: yes` at a line start.
  - `Fixes #12124` is the only closing keyword in the body.
  - Assignee `zhuangjianguo`.
- **Scope:** 14 files, +205/−5, all inside the claim's file surface (`6108325399`):
  - `data-table.tsx`: the four `aria-label`s and four `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` rows;
  - the `table` block of all ten packs (four real translations each, no English);
  - the objectui#12123 test moved to a role and name query;
  - one new pin file;
  - one changeset.

  Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`. `check-governed-merges --pr`: NOT governed, 210 changed lines.
- **Contract review:** `6109713074`, PASS on this head (an isolated subagent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). It settles `Clause-②: yes`: the exported `en` pack, and so `TranslationKeys`, widens by four `table` members. `@object-ui/i18n` is `minor`, `@object-ui/components` is `patch`.
- **Changeset, checked sentence by sentence against the diff after patch round 1 (`1b02eac`):**
  - "an ungrouped paged `ObjectGrid` draws" plus the grouped-pager carve-out naming objectui#12143. The grouped grid draws `ObjectGrid`'s own `groupedPager`, which this diff does not touch.
  - "The exported `en` pack, and so `TranslationKeys`, gains the four `table` members; no export or prop is added": matches `en.ts`'s `typeof en` and the unchanged export lists.
  - "Sighted use is unchanged": only `aria-label` attributes are added.
  - The four English names match the `en` pack and the defaults rows.
- **Tests:** the new pin walks a real paged `ObjectGrid`:
  - it finds each button by role and the pack's name and drives it to the page it names;
  - it checks the disabled ends, so two swapped keys are red;
  - under `zh` it reads the `zh` names and finds no English ones.

  Red on BASE (a `data-table.tsx` blob swap): 3 failed. Ablations B (next) and C (first/last swapped) were red as predicted, with every restore blob-equal.
- **Gates on this head** (read at 2026-10-11T13:52Z): 40 success, 3 skipped by design (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)` and the coverage-shard placeholder), 0 failure. `Lint`, `Type Check` and `Test` all read `success`.

### Out-of-scope findings

- **The grouped grid's own pager** (`groupedPager`, the same four unnamed buttons): filed objectui#12143.
- **"Row actions" in English in every locale**, escalated by the contract review: filed objectui#12145. It is one of 31 literal-English `aria-label`s the seat enumerated on `main` `dca25af`, so it is filed as that family's closing card, not as a single-site card.

### Acceptance notes

- The ratchet pair at `1b02eac` is NOT MEASURED locally (verify-lock queue timeout). The patch round touched only the changeset, the pair was green at `cae900c`, and CI is green on this head.

**Landing:** ready and auto-merge through the merge queue now.
